reuse.why: The change extends getScheduledAmount, routes existing calculations and the API consumer through it, and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: Previously duplicated amount calculations are replaced with calls to one shared definition.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy remains in shared/schedules, tolerance stays in shared/rules, and API projection stays in api-models.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested amount policy, its consumers, API exposure, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized policy makes future changes straightforward, although typing the new operator as string leaves the interface less precise than the existing operator types allow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All changed amount consumers delegate to getScheduledAmount, which delegates tolerance calculation to getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff removes local amount calculations rather than renaming or reshaping copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op option and an isapprox conditional; both represent required domain variation, while inverse already existed.
